resources.string: Driftless uses this to count the Reels and Shorts you watch in Instagram and YouTube. It only works in those two apps. It reads the video player screen to tell one video from the next, turns that into an unreadable code straight away, and keeps only the count on this phone. It never reads your messages, never takes screenshots, never taps or types for you, and sends nothing anywhere unless you turn on sync, which only shares daily totals.
